issues.problem: “Connected” and “Move cursor by tilting your phone” have insufficient text contrast, and the touchpad’s scroll thumb and arrows fall below the 3:1 contrast requirement for controls.
issues.edit: Darken the muted text to at least 4.5:1 contrast and the scroll thumb and arrows to at least 3:1 against their backgrounds.

issues.problem: The “Right click” icon highlights the mouse’s upper-left button, contradicting its label.
issues.edit: Move the highlighted mouse segment to the upper-right button in the “Right click” icon.
